val [name](name.html): [String](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-string/index.html)

An optional explicit name for the parameter. When set, both the KSP path and `ReflectiveTools` use it as the schema name; when unset, the KSP path uses the Kotlin parameter name, while the reflective path requires it because Java does not retain parameter names in bytecode.
